units.passage: Fabrication: using AI to create counterfeit citations, interview responses, or research results.
units.why: Fabrication is 'using AI to create counterfeit citations, interview responses, or research results': P74.

units.passage: Submitting materials containing misinformation or unethical content.
units.why: Students may be penalized for "Submitting materials containing misinformation or unethical content." Rule against submitting misinformation, P74.
units.fit_note: Penalizes submitting misinformation, not only deceptive use of AI.

units.passage: Don’t use it for illegal activities, to violate others' rights, or to discuss sensitive topics that could risk others' privacy and security.
units.why: Says 'Don't use it for illegal activities, to violate others' rights'; a general conduct ban (P74).
units.fit_note: Also covers discussing sensitive topics that risk others' privacy.

units.passage: University students and employees are expected to refrain from utilizing AI to in any way threaten University systems or security.
units.why: Students and employees 'are expected to refrain from utilizing AI to in any way threaten University systems or security', a conduct ban on security-threatening AI use. P74 (malicious AI use) fits; P75 is about phishing awareness, which this is not.

units.passage: University members must not use AI tools to willfully generate or disseminate fraudulent, defamatory, harassing, or obscene content, or any material that would violate laws or university standards if produced by a human.
units.why: Members 'must not use AI tools to willfully generate or disseminate fraudulent, defamatory, harassing, or obscene content'. A general ban on deceptive or harassing AI content is P74.

units.passage: (A) Within the scope of the employee's regular job duties; or (B) Requested by an elected official or public entity; (2) Engage in lobbying an elected official on a personal opinion if the employee is not a registered lobbyist for the public entity; (3) Engage in illegal activities or activities otherwise prohibited by federal law or state law; or (4) Intentionally override or avoid the security and system integrity procedures of the public entity.
units.why: The Act 848 list also bars AI use to 'override or avoid the security and system integrity procedures', a security-breaching use, P74.

units.passage: AI may not be used in ways that constitute discrimination or harassment as define under University policy, especially in contexts like employment, admissions, student evaluations, or resource allocation.
units.why: 'AI may not be used in ways that constitute discrimination or harassment ... especially in contexts like employment, admissions, student evaluations, or resource allocation' is a conduct ban on discriminatory AI use. P74 is nearest (deceptive or harassing use).
units.fit_note: Bans discriminatory use; P74 lists harassment but not discrimination in employment, admissions and evaluation.

units.passage: Using AI to hide plagiarism or to mislead readers about the provenance of your submitted work
units.why: "Using AI to hide plagiarism or to mislead readers about the provenance of your submitted work" bans deceptive use, P74.

units.passage: So-called deepfakes and hallucinations must be acknowledged and must not be used fraudulently.
units.why: "deepfakes and hallucinations must be acknowledged and must not be used fraudulently" bans deceptive AI use, so P74 fits.
units.fit_note: Also includes duty to vet content and not transmit deepfakes.

units.passage: AI may not be used in a manner that creates a conflict of interest. Policy on Harassment (PDF) All employees are required to comply with the University’s Policy on Harassment. Harassment is defined as conduct and/or expression that is not protected by the First Amendment to the United States Constitution or Article I of the Ohio Constitution because it is unwelcome; and so severe, pervasive, and objectively offensive that it effectively denies an individual equal access to the individual's education program or activity. AI may not be used to engage in any form of harassment
units.why: "AI may not be used to engage in any form of harassment" is a general ban on malicious AI use, P74.

units.passage: AI should not be used to deceive, manipulate, misrepresent, circumvent established requirements or controls, or compromise the integrity of research, scholarship, teaching, or other academic work.
units.why: "AI should not be used to deceive, manipulate, misrepresent, circumvent established requirements" is a general conduct ban on deceptive use, and the passage extends to "the integrity of ... teaching, or other academic work" (P74).

units.passage: GenAI representations, or GenAI driven representations (images, 3D objects, video or voice) of real people must not be created or distributed without their explicit, informed consent, unless the use is intended to support academic freedom.
units.why: "must not be created or distributed without their explicit, informed consent" bans AI likenesses of real people without consent (P74).
units.fit_note: Includes an exception for academic freedom and extends to public-facing university content.

units.passage: GenAI tools may not be used to intentionally create sexualized content (including images, 3D objects, video or audio) depicting real individuals. Under no circumstances may sexualized or suggestive depictions of minors be created, regardless of their relation (or lack thereof) to real people.
units.why: "GenAI tools may not be used to intentionally create sexualized content ... depicting real individuals" is a conduct ban on harmful content (P74).

units.passage: Using GenAI to forge documents may also be a violation of the Student Code of Conduct.
units.why: "Using GenAI to forge documents may also be a violation of the Student Code of Conduct" is a conduct rule against using AI to falsify records, so P74.

units.passage: Instructing GenAI to alter, change, or skew results may be considered falsification.
units.why: "Instructing GenAI to alter, change, or skew results may be considered falsification" bans using AI to falsify data. P74 (falsify data) fits its definition; it is also misconduct (P36) but the act described is falsification.

units.passage: Including fake sources, data, or citations that an AI made up in a research paper or bibliography.
units.why: "Including fake sources, data, or citations that an AI made up" is misconduct. It forbids submitting fabricated material that AI produced, which is closest to P74 (fabricate or falsify data); P31 only tells students to verify.
units.fit_note: Concerns AI-fabricated sources in the student's own submission, not intent to deceive by the tool user in general.

units.passage: University users must not use Generative AI tools to generate malicious content, such as malware, viruses, worms, and trojan horses that may have the ability to circumvent access control measures put in place by the University, or any other third-party entity, to prevent unauthorized access to their respective networks.
units.why: "must not use Generative AI tools to generate malicious content, such as malware" is a general conduct ban on malicious AI use, so P74; must-not.

units.passage: University users must not use Generative AI to generate content that facilitates sexual harassment, stalking, or sexual exploitation 13 ; or that helps others break federal, state, or local laws; institutional policies, rules, or guidelines; or licensing agreements or contracts.
units.why: "must not use Generative AI to generate content that facilitates sexual harassment, stalking, or sexual exploitation; or that helps others break ... laws" is a conduct ban on harmful AI use, so P74; must-not.

units.passage: use AI to deceive, misinform, or avoid accountability
units.why: 'use AI to deceive, misinform, or avoid accountability' is a general conduct ban on deceptive use (P74).

units.passage: AI should be used in ways that respect human values, rights, and dignity, and that promote social, economic, and environmental benefits for all. AI should be transparent, explainable, and accountable, and individuals should be informed and empowered to understand, challenge, and remedy AI-based AI should be reliable, safe, and secure, and its accuracy and effectiveness should be evaluated and verified for the intended use. AI should be available broadly, and its development and implementation should consider many perspectives and experiences. AI should be used in ways that uphold academic freedom, integrity, and excellence, and that foster interdisciplinary collaboration and innovation. AI should be used in ways that adhere to the principles of data privacy, applicable laws and regulations, and that protect personal data and intellectual property AI should be used in ways that avoid and mitigate bias and that proactively identify and avoid causing any harm. AI should be used in ways that are transparent and ethical, and that never deceive or spread
units.why: 'never deceive or spread' (misinformation) is a conduct principle against deceptive use (P74).
units.fit_note: The extracted sentence is truncated after 'spread'.

units.passage: GenAI tools must not be used for illegal, discriminatory, or defamatory purposes.
units.why: 'GenAI tools must not be used for illegal, discriminatory, or defamatory purposes' is a general conduct ban, P74.

units.passage: Click to expand GenAI tools must not be used for malware or spam purposes.
units.why: 'GenAI tools must not be used for malware or spam purposes' bans malicious use, P74.

units.passage: Prohibited activities include, but are not limited to use of Generative AI for unauthorized access, disruption, harassment, or obscene material.
units.why: 'Prohibited activities include ... unauthorized access, disruption, harassment, or obscene material'; general conduct bans, P74.

units.passage: Generative AI may not be used to generate malicious content, such as malware, viruses, or any other content that may have the ability to circumvent the University of Maine System’s (or other third-party entity’s) access control measures.
units.why: 'Generative AI may not be used to generate malicious content, such as malware, viruses'; malicious-use ban, P74.

units.passage: GenAI tools should not be used to fabricate, falsify, or misrepresent information, impersonate individuals, or generate deceptive content except when intentionally employed by instructors or researchers for pedagogical or research purposes in a controlled and ethical manner.
units.why: Says GenAI "should not be used to fabricate, falsify, or misrepresent information, impersonate individuals, or generate deceptive content". A general conduct ban, P74.

units.passage: GenAI tools should not be used to fabricate, falsify, or misrepresent information, impersonate individuals, or generate deceptive content except when intentionally employed by instructors or researchers for pedagogical or research purposes in a controlled and ethical manner.
units.why: The same sentence excepts instructors or researchers using deceptive content "for pedagogical or research purposes in a controlled and ethical manner". An exception to P74, kept as its own rule.
units.fit_note: An exception allowing instructors and researchers controlled deceptive content, not a ban.

units.passage: GenAI tools should not be used to fabricate, falsify, or misrepresent information, impersonate individuals, or generate deceptive content except when intentionally employed by instructors or researchers for pedagogical or research purposes in a controlled and ethical manner.
units.policy: GenAI tools should not be used to fabricate, falsify or misrepresent information, impersonate individuals or generate deceptive content, except when intentionally employed by instructors or researchers for pedagogical or research purposes in a controlled and ethical manner.
units.why: General conduct rule: GenAI 'should not be used to fabricate, falsify, or misrepresent information, impersonate individuals, or generate deceptive content', with a pedagogical-research exception. Deceptive use is P74.

units.passage: Any discrimination of use of Gen AI that leads to discrimination or bias against individuals or groups is strictly prohibited.
units.why: "Any discrimination of use of Gen AI that leads to discrimination or bias against individuals or groups is strictly prohibited" is a conduct ban on discriminatory AI use, P74.
units.fit_note: Bans discriminatory outcomes rather than deception, fabrication or malice.

units.passage: AI use that misrepresents Morehouse College or violates copyright/IP rights
units.why: "AI use that misrepresents Morehouse College or violates copyright/IP rights" is prohibited; the copyright part fits P52, the misrepresentation part is a fit note.
units.fit_note: Misrepresentation of the College only; the copyright and IP clause is a separate unit.

units.passage: Using AI image generators to create visuals for storyboards. Using AI to help with grammar and spelling checks. Using AI to explain confusing concepts in simple language. Using AI to translate text from one language to another. Using AI to help diagnose error messages. Unacceptable uses: Using AI to generate content for assignments. Using AI image generators to create visuals for journalism or fact-based reporting, photojournalism or anything you’re creating that’s represented as real.
units.why: 'visuals for journalism or fact-based reporting ... anything you're creating that's represented as real' forbids AI images passed off as real, nearest P74 (deceptive AI use).
units.fit_note: Specific to AI images presented as real in journalism-type assignments. | Targets AI images passed off as real in journalism, not general deception, fabrication or malware.

units.passage: avoid using AI in ways that deceive, manipulate, harass, or harm others
units.why: Principle 9 tells members to "avoid using AI in ways that deceive, manipulate, harass, or harm others", a conduct ban matching P74.

units.passage: Among other things, UNE prohibits using AI to: • Collect, monitor, or surveil personal information without authorization
units.why: "UNE prohibits using AI to collect, monitor, or surveil personal information without authorization", a conduct ban, P74.

units.passage: Create or distribute material that violates privacy or University policies concerning harassment or discrimination
units.why: "Create or distribute material that violates privacy or University policies concerning harassment or discrimination" is a conduct ban, P74.

units.passage: Create malicious software or other content designed to bypass security or gain unauthorized access
units.why: "Create malicious software or other content designed to bypass security or gain unauthorized access" is a conduct ban, P74.

units.passage: You may not use AI to misrepresent your learning, fabricate sources or data, create misleading images or visual evidence
units.why: 'You may not use AI to misrepresent your learning, fabricate sources or data, create misleading images'; deception and fabrication ban, P74.

units.passage: Fabricate citations, sources, quotations, data, images, visual evidence, audio, video, or other media;
units.why: Not permitted: 'Fabricate citations, sources, quotations, data, images, visual evidence'; P74.

units.passage: Create misleading, deceptive, or manipulated images, figures, charts, audio, video, or visual evidence;
units.why: Not permitted: 'Create misleading, deceptive, or manipulated images, figures, charts, audio, video, or visual evidence'; P74.

units.passage: Create, edit, imitate, or manipulate images, voices, likenesses, or identifiable attributes of real people
units.why: Not permitted: 'Create, edit, imitate, or manipulate images, voices, likenesses ... of real people without explicit permission'; nearest P74, with a consent angle.
units.fit_note: Focus is on consent for likeness and voice. | Focuses on consent for real people's likenesses and voices.

units.passage: Misinformation : AI can create misinformation, disrupting University processes.
units.why: Disruptive Behavior row: "AI can create misinformation, disrupting University processes"; this is a conduct concern about deceptive or malicious AI use, P74.

units.passage: Interference with Teaching : AI can generate fake scholarly content or tools that potentially undermine academics.
units.why: "AI can generate fake scholarly content or tools that potentially undermine academics" names fabrication in teaching, P74.

units.passage: Unauthorized Use of Property : AI can access or manipulate University systems without permission.
units.why: "AI can access or manipulate University systems without permission" ties unauthorized property use to AI, a malicious-use concern, P74.

units.passage: Disruption of Functions : AI can automate actions that programmatically disrupt University functions.
units.why: "AI can automate actions that programmatically disrupt University functions" is a malicious-use concern, P74.

units.passage: Endangerment/Disruptive Behavior: Use of AI to cyberbully, harass, stalk or do harm.
units.why: "Use of AI to cyberbully, harass, stalk or do harm" is listed as a code-of-conduct violation, P74.

units.passage: Do not generate or share content that is defamatory, discriminatory, or otherwise violates our Po licy on the Appropriate Use of Computer and Network Resources and Code of Ethical Conduct
units.why: "Do not generate or share content that is defamatory, discriminatory, or otherwise violates our Policy" is a general conduct ban on harmful content, P74.

units.passage: Misleading others about the origin of the content
units.why: A strict-policy example bars "misleading others about the origin of the content", deceptive use, P74.

units.passage: While you have flexibility in how you use AI, avoid unintentional plagiarism or data fabrication.
units.why: Students should 'avoid unintentional plagiarism or data fabrication' when using AI; no type is exact, P74 (fabrication) is nearest.
units.fit_note: Also covers unintentional plagiarism, not only deliberate deception.

units.passage: In addition, you must be wary of unintentional plagiarism or fabrication of data.
units.why: 'you must be wary of unintentional plagiarism or fabrication of data' tells students to guard against plagiarism and fabricated data when using AI. It is addressed to students, during work; 'must' is the text's word; P74 is nearest (fabrication), P31 not chosen because the focus is avoiding plagiarism and fabrication, not checking output.
units.fit_note: Warns about unintentional plagiarism too.

units.passage: Submitting data or research that is not real (a risk when overly relying on Generative AI) may result in an academic integrity violation for falsifying information.
units.why: "Submitting data or research that is not real ... may result in an academic integrity violation for falsifying information" bans fabricated data and names its consequence (P74).
units.fit_note: Frames fabricated data from AI over-reliance as an integrity violation.

units.passage: Consider the potential for misuse of AI-generated content, such as creating misleading information or deepfakes, and how to prevent misuse in your classroom.
units.why: Consider 'the potential for misuse of AI-generated content, such as creating misleading information or deepfakes' (P74).
units.fit_note: Asks instructors to consider and prevent misuse; no conduct ban for students.

units.passage: Don’t use GenAI to complete assignments unless you have explicit permission. Data Falsification: Don’t use GenAI to generate or alter data in ways that misrepresent your findings.
units.why: Data falsification: "Don't use GenAI to generate or alter data in ways that misrepresent your findings". Ban on fabricating or falsifying data: P74.

units.passage: SLU community members are prohibited from using generative AI tools to generate malicious content, such as malware, viruses, worms and trojan horses that may have the ability to circumvent access control measures put in place by SLU or any other third-party entity
units.why: 'prohibited from using generative AI tools to generate malicious content, such as malware' bans malicious AI uses, P74.

units.passage: SLU community members are prohibited from using generative AI tools to generate malicious content, such as malware, viruses, worms and trojan horses that may have the ability to circumvent access control measures put in place by SLU or any other third-party entity to prevent unauthorized access to their respective networks. SLU community members are prohibited from using AI tools with the intent to harm another person.
units.why: "prohibited from using AI tools with the intent to harm another person" is a second, separate conduct ban on harmful AI use, P74.

units.passage: and avoid using AI to mislead, discriminate, manipulate, or misrepresent.
units.why: "avoid using AI to mislead, discriminate, manipulate, or misrepresent" is a general conduct ban on deceptive or discriminatory AI use, P74.
units.fit_note: Sits beside prompts to respect privacy and challenge biased outputs; the ban on misleading or discriminatory use is the type assigned.

units.passage: Using AI tools for unlawful, unethical, discriminatory, or harassing purposes
units.why: Bans using AI for "unlawful, unethical, discriminatory, or harassing purposes", a general conduct rule; P74.

units.passage: Circumventing District security, privacy, or governance controls
units.why: Bans "Circumventing District security, privacy, or governance controls". No type is about circumvention of controls; P77 (follow existing rules) is the nearest.
units.fit_note: Concerns circumventing the District's security, privacy and governance controls rather than deception or malware specifically.

units.passage: Using AI to generate fake survey results or lab data.
units.why: Fabrication violation: 'Using AI to generate fake survey results or lab data'; deceptive fabricated data (P74).

units.passage: Letting AI “hallucinate” references and including them as if real.
units.why: "Letting AI hallucinate references and including them as if real" is a fabrication violation; P74 fits fabricated records, and the unit also implies verification.
units.fit_note: Concerns hallucinated references included as if real; close to P31 (verify AI output), but the table frames it as a fabrication violation.

units.passage: Generating false, misleading, or plagiarized content: Even when GenAI tools are authorized for use, students are ultimately responsible for the accuracy of the content and that that content is not plagiarized.
units.why: "Generating false, misleading, or plagiarized content" is banned even when AI is allowed, a ban on fabrication (P74).

units.passage: Using artificial intelligence to fabricate a doctor's excuse and using it to justify an absence.
units.why: Under Falsification: 'Using artificial intelligence to fabricate a doctor's excuse and using it to justify an absence'; AI used to fabricate records, P74.

units.passage: Malicious Activities: AI must not be used for illegal, unethical, or policy violating activities.
units.why: 'AI must not be used for illegal, unethical, or policy violating activities' is a conduct rule against malicious use: P74.

units.passage: Unauthorized Data Access: AI tools must not be used to access or manipulate data without authorization.
units.why: 'AI tools must not be used to access or manipulate data without authorization', a security conduct ban: P74.

units.passage: Prohibited Use – AI tools may not be used for: o Generating misinformation, defamatory content, or academic dishonesty;
units.why: AI tools may not be used for "Generating misinformation, defamatory content, or academic dishonesty". A general conduct ban on deceptive use, P74.

units.passage: Facilitating cybersecurity threats, malware, or phishing;
units.why: The ban on 'Facilitating cybersecurity threats, malware, or phishing' is a security-misuse ban; P74 (malicious use) rather than P75, which urges vigilance against AI-enabled phishing.

units.passage: Assisting in discriminatory practices, harassment, or illegal activities.
units.why: AI may not be used for "Assisting in discriminatory practices, harassment, or illegal activities". Harmful-use ban, P74.

units.passage: Gen AI Tools of any sort cannot be used for any activity that would be illegal, unethical, fraudulent or violate any state or federal law or UTA or UT System policies.
units.why: A blanket rule that GenAI cannot be used for illegal, unethical or fraudulent activity is a general conduct ban, P74 (deceptive or malicious use), not P77 because it names fraud and unethical use directly.
units.fit_note: Also bans activity that violates state or federal law or UTA or UT System policies (P77).

units.passage: Fraudulent or Illegal Activities - AI tools must not be used for activities that are illegal, fraudulent, or violate any state or federal laws, or UT Austin or UT System policies.
units.policy: AI tools must not be used for activities that are illegal, fraudulent, or violate any state or federal laws, or UT Austin or UT System policies.
units.why: "AI tools must not be used for activities that are illegal, fraudulent, or violate any state or federal laws, or UT Austin or UT System policies" is a general conduct ban; P74 (fraud) chosen over P77 because the heading and core concern is illegal and fraudulent activity.
units.fit_note: Also bans violating laws and university policies (P77 territory).

units.passage: Generative AI tools may not be used for any activity that would be considered illegal or fraudulent,
units.why: "may not be used for any activity that would be considered illegal or fraudulent" is a general conduct ban on unlawful or fraudulent AI use (P74).

units.passage: AI tools must not be used for activities that are illegal, fraudulent, or violate any state or federal laws, or TTUHSC or TTU System policies.
units.why: AI 'must not be used for activities that are illegal, fraudulent, or violate any state or federal laws', a general conduct ban, so P74.

units.passage: Do not use AI tools to create malicious content, including malware, viruses, worms, or trojan horses, or to bypass TTUHSC or third-party network security controls.
units.why: 'Do not use AI tools to create malicious content, including malware, viruses, worms, or trojan horses', a conduct ban, so P74.

units.policy: AI may not be used to fabricate data or perform analyses that misrepresent the project.
units.why: 'AI may not be used to fabricate data or perform analyses that misrepresent the project' is a ban on fabrication, P74.

units.passage: Discriminatory, biased, malicious, or harmful use of AI is strictly prohibited.
units.why: A flat ban on "discriminatory, biased, malicious, or harmful use of AI" for all users. A general conduct rule, so P74 and unit_stance prohibit.

units.passage: Generating content that is illegal under federal or state law, including child sexual abuse material (CSAM), credible threats, or any other content prohibited by law or USU policy.
units.why: 'Generating content that is illegal under federal or state law, including child sexual abuse material' is a prohibited use: a general conduct ban, P74.

units.passage: Creating AI-generated images, audio, or video (deepfakes) that realistically impersonate a real person without their consent, or that are designed to deceive, harass, defame, or cause harm.
units.why: Prohibited use: creating deepfakes that 'impersonate a real person without their consent' or are 'designed to deceive, harass, defame'. Matches P74 (deceptive or malicious use).

units.passage: Using AI to generate content that impersonates another individual in ways intended to deceive, or that the individual has not authorized.
units.why: 'Using AI to generate content that impersonates another individual in ways intended to deceive' is a ban on deceptive AI use, P74.

units.passage: Using AI tools to probe, exploit, or bypass university security measures, access controls, or authentication systems.
units.why: 'Using AI tools to probe, exploit, or bypass university security measures' is a ban on malicious AI use that breaches security: P74 (the type lists breaching security).

units.passage: Refrain from inputting or producing imagery, video, or audio of another person’s likeness or voice in an AI tool without their express permission.
units.why: 'Refrain from inputting or producing imagery, video, or audio of another person's likeness or voice' without permission: a ban on deceptive or harmful use of likeness, P74.

units.passage: AI can support your work, but it shouldn’t replace thoughtful judgment or be used to mislead.
units.why: AI should not 'be used to mislead' is a conduct rule against deceptive use. P74 fits because it bans deceptive use in general.

units.passage: AI-generated content, including deepfakes and synthetic media, can be used maliciously to deceive, manipulate, or harm individuals
units.why: AI deepfakes "can be used maliciously to deceive, manipulate, or harm individuals," a warning about malicious AI use, P74.

units.passage: Community members should not create or distribute deepfake content without explicit consent from the individuals depicted.
units.why: "Community members should not create or distribute deepfake content without explicit consent"; rule against deceptive or harmful AI use, P74.

units.why: 'You may not upload any data that could be used to help create or carry out malware, spam and phishing campaigns' bans malicious use of AI (P74).

units.policy: You may not direct AI tools or services to generate content that facilitates sexual harassment, stalking or sexual exploitation.
units.why: 'You may not direct AI tools or services to generate content that facilitates sexual harassment, stalking or sexual exploitation' bans harmful generation (P74).

UW-503 Cybersecurity Risk Management SYS 1039 Risk Management UW-124 HIPAA Security Risk Management Use of malicious code in IT systems or services may threaten or increase the vulnerability of systems and the university data such systems store or transmit. units.policy: You may not use AI tools or services to generate content that helps others break federal, state or local laws; institutional policies, rules or guidelines; or licensing agreements or contracts.
